description: This file defines the 'Quantity' type used in Kubernetes to represent fixed-point resource quantities, including parsing, serialization, and arithmetic operations.

classes.name: Quantity
classes.description: Represents a fixed-point number with methods for parsing, serialization, arithmetic, and comparison.

classes.name: CanonicalValue
classes.description: Interface for converting quantities to canonical byte representations.

classes.name: Format
classes.description: Enumeration of the three formatting styles for quantities: DecimalExponent, BinarySI, DecimalSI.

methods.name: MustParse
methods.description: Parses a string into a Quantity or panics if invalid.

methods.name: ParseQuantity
methods.description: Parses a string into a Quantity, handling different suffixes and formats.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Quantity.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the Quantity, caching the result.

methods.name: MarshalJSON
methods.description: Serializes the Quantity to JSON.

methods.name: UnmarshalJSON
methods.description: Deserializes JSON data into the Quantity.

methods.name: AsApproximateFloat64
methods.description: Returns an approximate float64 value of the Quantity.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds another Quantity to this one.

methods.name: Sub
methods.description: Subtracts another Quantity from this one.

methods.name: Mul
methods.description: Multiplies the Quantity by an int64.

methods.name: Cmp
methods.description: Compares this Quantity with another.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the Quantity to a specific int64 value.

methods.name: SetMilli
methods.description: Sets the Quantity to a value times 1/1000.

methods.name: SetScaled
methods.description: Sets the Quantity to a value times 10^scale.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Returns the unscaled integer value of the Quantity.

methods.name: MilliValue
methods.description: Returns the value times 1000.

methods.name: ScaledValue
methods.description: Returns the value scaled to a specific decimal place.

methods.name: IsZero
methods.description: Checks if the Quantity is zero.

methods.name: Sign
methods.description: Returns the sign of the Quantity.

methods.name: AsScale
methods.description: Returns the Quantity scaled to a specific scale.

methods.name: RoundUp
methods.description: Rounds the Quantity up to a specific scale.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Checks equality with another Quantity.

methods.name: CanonicalizeBytes
methods.description: Returns the canonical byte form of the Quantity.

methods.name: AsFloat64Slow
methods.description: Returns a precise float64 approximation.

methods.name: ToDec
methods.description: Converts the Quantity to inf.Dec form.

methods.name: AsDec
methods.description: Returns the Quantity as inf.Dec.

methods.name: AsCanonicalBytes
methods.description: Returns the canonical byte representation.
